summary: Iteration 16: WhatsApp Bot AI Conversation Logic Testing Complete. All 11 tests passed (100%). Tested the key bot fixes: returning client greeting by name, new client introduction, catalog link always sent, product search with filtered links, no error fallback messages, single response per message, conversation continuity (no redundant Hola), concurrent message handling, error messages filtered from history, and load_known_client_data only returns contact info.

✓ No 'gracias por contactarnos, en un momento' in responses
single_response_per_message: ✓ Bot sends only 1 message per user message (no double messages)
conversation_continuity: ✓ Follow-up messages don't start with redundant 'Hola'
✓ Second response: 'Por el momento no tenemos jarros disponibles...' (no Hola prefix)

✓ Per-phone concurrency lock ensures sequential processing
error_messages_filtered_from_history: ✓ Error fallback messages filtered from conversation history
✓ Bot doesn't read old error messages

✓ Does NOT return product fields: codigos_producto, producto_interes, cantidad_estimada

critical_code_review_comments: All key bot fixes verified working:
2. Broader catalog keyword detection working - 'catálogo', 'envíame el catálogo', 'quiero ver el catálogo' all trigger catalog link
3. load_known_client_data only loads contact data (nombre, empresa, ciudad, correo) - NOT product codes
4. Per-phone concurrency lock (_phone_locks) prevents race conditions with rapid messages
5. Error handler doesn't send fallback if message was already sent (message_sent flag)
6. Conversation history filters out error fallback messages (ERROR_FALLBACKS list in get_conversation_history)
7. Post-processing removes redundant 'Hola' greetings from follow-up messages (regex in lines 1001-1008)
